summary: Public projects created on 17 October 2026: 2 datasets.
intro: Two audio datasets cover read-aloud English speech: one of plain everyday sentences with homophone pairs, and a small hand-picked set of real voice notes.

projects.name: Annotated Voice Notes
projects.description: A small, hand-picked set of real voice notes. It is kept small on purpose.

projects.name: General English Sentences
projects.description: Plain, everyday English sentences (emails, messages, general prose and homophone pairs) read aloud by one speaker, with no Hebrew or Yiddish words, Israeli names or tech vocabulary.
